dotnet-bac2dac 1.0.0

Rewrites a .bacpac (schema + data) into a .dacpac (schema only).

Usage:
  dotnet-bac2dac <input.bacpac> [output.dacpac] [options]

Arguments:
  <input.bacpac>       The package to read.
  [output.dacpac]      Where to write the result. Defaults to the input
                       path with the extension replaced by .dacpac.

Options:
  -o, --output <path>  Same as the positional output argument.
  -f, --force          Overwrite the output file if it already exists.
  -q, --quiet          Print nothing unless something goes wrong.
  -v, --version        Print the version and exit.
  -h, --help           Print this help and exit.

Examples:
  dotnet-bac2dac AdventureWorks.bacpac
  dotnet-bac2dac AdventureWorks.bacpac ./out/schema.dacpac
  dotnet-bac2dac AdventureWorks.bacpac --force --quiet
